modelDetails.type: Time series foundation model (encoder-only, zero-shot forecasting)
modelDetails.architecture: 120M parameters, encoder-only, inspired by the T5 encoder, with group attention
modelDetails.description: Chronos-2 supports univariate, multivariate and covariate-informed forecasting in a single architecture and produces multi-step-ahead quantile forecasts.

intendedUse.primaryIntendedUseCases: Zero-shot forecasting of univariate time series; multivariate forecasting; forecasting informed by past-only and known-future covariates; cross-learning across related series

factors.hardware: GPU and CPU inference; over 300 time series forecasts per second on a single A10G GPU
factors.software: Python package chronos-forecasting 2.0 or later; deployment on Amazon SageMaker with AutoGluon-Cloud (recommended) or SageMaker JumpStart

evaluation.performance: State-of-the-art zero-shot accuracy among public models on fev-bench, GIFT-Eval and Chronos Benchmark II

trainingData.dataset: Subset of the Chronos Datasets (excluding the test portion of datasets that overlap with GIFT-Eval); subset of GIFT-Eval Pretrain; synthetic univariate and multivariate data

modelCardContent.caveatsAndRecommendations: For production use, deploy Chronos-2 on Amazon SageMaker, preferably with AutoGluon-Cloud; maximum context length is 8192 and maximum prediction length is 1024
